contexts.text: The heavenly Societies act... by an influx gentle, soft, delightful.
The Angels (are commanded to act) gently with man.
An influx like that of a most gentle stream... Although it acted gently, still it acted strongly...

The influx (of the Spirits of Jupiter) was so gentle and sweet that it cannot be expressed. In the other life uprightness manifests itself by gentleness and sweetness. Their gentleness and sweetness could be most clearly distinguished from the gentleness and sweetness of the good Spirits of our Earth. EU 50.
